messages:
Asha (CSM): FYI renewal for Vortex Labs is due next Tue. They want to shorten to 6 months and keep current rate. Procurement insists on vendor code + PO. Also asked if we can do CC as backup for a wire delay.
Tom (AE): Got it. Do we have current ARR and any outstanding credits?
Asha (CSM): ARR = $72k annualized. We offered a one-time 10% credit during last renewal conversation (they accepted verbally). No outstanding invoices.
Nadia (Finance): Vendor code needed + billing entity. Who is the legal payor?
Asha (CSM): They gave two entities in EU: Vortex EU Ltd (VAT ID: GB123456789) and Vortex Inc (US). Procurement prefers EU invoice.
Nadia (Finance): Ok — can you confirm invoice ship-to and PO number when they send it. If they pay by card we can finalize faster; wiring needs 5 business days.
Leo (SE): Quick technical note: they requested KMS attestation for key management (HSM). That blocks Private deployment until legal signs the attestation. Timeline wise, we can do a scoped attestation doc in 3 business days if Priya ok.
Priya (Legal): I can draft an attestation addendum. Need list of required clauses from SE. Leo, can you paste the minimal language?
Leo (SE): Minimal asks: "Customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM, we will provide attestation of zero plaintext export and audit logs for key access." Example snippet: ```We confirm key material is not exported and access logs retained for 90 days.```
Priya (Legal): Good. I'll circulate a 1-page addendum. Asha, confirm who will sign (CFO vs Head of IT)?
Asha (CSM): They said CFO signs commercial, Head of IT signs attestation. CFO wants consolidated SOW + PO before signature.
Tom (AE): Can we keep pricing same but make term 6 months with prorated billing? Need approval from revenue ops on short-term commit. @Nadia any objections?
Nadia (Finance): Short-term commit ok if we invoice up front for 6 months. Otherwise we need a billing cadence and collection plan.
Asha (CSM): Customer prefers net30 on the PO. If they insist, we should confirm their CC fallback option in case wire misses.
Leo (SE): Enablement note: onboarding team needs confirmation of production window. We have a 2-week enablement slot next Tue/Thu. If they sign by EOD Thu we can schedule.
Asha (CSM): I'll push for EOD Thu. Also capture their feedback request: they want SAML multi-tenant support and smaller-model pricing. Logged in our post-sale ask doc.
Tom (AE): To summarize actions: 1) Priya to send attestation addendum 2) Nadia to confirm billing path for EU entity 3) Asha to get PO/CF0 signature timeline 4) Leo to confirm enablement slot after signature.
Priya (Legal): Drafted addendum, uploading now. @deploy-bot please drop link.
deploy-bot: Document uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/attestations/vortex-kms-addendum-draft-v1.docx :paperclip:
Asha (CSM): Thanks — I'll share the doc and ask them to indicate signer roles. If CFO signs commercial but delays, recommend card fallback to avoid losing enablement window. :thumbsup:
Tom (AE): Also flagging renewal risk: if they push past next Tue onboarding slot we lose momentum and they may seek competitor pilot. Marking as high risk.
Asha (CSM): Noted. I'll escalate in the customer-facing thread and request PO + signer names today.
Nadia (Finance): If PO is EU and net30, finance holds invoice until PO arrives. For CC fallback, we need billing contact and card auth form.
Asha (CSM): Will collect and update here. Thanks everyone.
